subject: english
question:
In the following question, out of the given four alternatives, select the alternative which best expresses the meaning of the Idiom / Phrase.

Back to basics

options.text: To love someone with whole heart
Returning to the simple and most important things

solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **"Back to basics"** means returning to the simple and most important aspects of something. (मूल बातें पर वापस जाना)

 
 
• **Example:** After struggling with the advanced techniques, the coach decided it was best to go **back to basics** and focus on fundamental skills.
 
 
 
• **"Returning to the simple and most important things"** signifies focusing on the fundamental aspects that are crucial. (सरल और सबसे महत्वपूर्ण चीजों पर वापस जाना)
 
 
• **Example:** In times of crisis, it's often wise to return to the simple and most important things to maintain stability.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **To love someone with whole heart** (पूरे दिल से किसी से प्यार करना): To have deep affection and strong emotional attachment to someone.

 
 
• **Example:** She loves her family with her whole heart.
 
 
 
• **Covering all the possibilities** (सभी संभावनाओं को कवर करना): Ensuring that every potential scenario or option is considered.
 
 
• **Example:** The comprehensive plan covers all the possibilities to avoid any unforeseen issues.
 
 
 
• **Back to where one started** (जहां से शुरू किया था वहां वापस जाना): To return to the original position or situation.
 
 
• **Example:** After months of negotiations, they are back to where they started with no progress made.
 
 

30:Tc99,
The correct answer is **Option 1**.
